<?php
class QuietMethodStaticInheritedCVBase { public static function counter() { static $counter = 0; $counter = $counter + 1; echo self::class; echo ">"; echo static::class; echo ";"; return $counter; } }
class QuietMethodStaticInheritedCVTarget extends qUIETmETHODsTATICiNHERITEDcvbASE {}
class QuietMethodStaticInheritedCVEmptyGet {
    private int $value = 41;
    public function __isset(string $incoming): bool { echo "I;"; return true; }
    public function __get(string $incoming): object { global $reader, $selector, $held; echo "G;"; $saved = $held; $held = null; $reader = null; $selector = "changed"; return $saved; }
    public function __destruct() { global $watch; echo "RECEIVER;"; echo $watch->get() === null ? "WRAPPER_GONE;" : "BAD_WRAPPER;";  }
}
$original = \qUIETmETHODsTATICiNHERITEDcvtARGET::counter(...);
echo $original() === 1 ? "FIRST;" : "BAD_FIRST;";
$intermediate = clone $original;
$held = clone $intermediate;
echo $held() === 2 ? "CLONE;" : "BAD_CLONE;";
$sourceWeak = WeakReference::create($original);
$intermediateWeak = WeakReference::create($intermediate);
$original = null;
$intermediate = null;
echo QuietMethodStaticInheritedCVBase::counter() === 3 ? "WARM;" : "BAD_WARM;";
echo $sourceWeak->get() === null && $intermediateWeak->get() === null ? "SOURCES_GONE;" : "BAD_SOURCE;";
$watch = WeakReference::create($held);
$reader = new QuietMethodStaticInheritedCVEmptyGet;
$readerWeak = WeakReference::create($reader);
$selector = "value";
$destination = 42;
$destination = empty($reader->$selector);
echo $destination === false ? "FALSE;" : "BAD_EMPTY;";
echo $held === null && $reader === null && $selector === "changed" ? "CAPTURE;" : "BAD_CAPTURE;";
echo $readerWeak->get() === null ? "RECEIVER_GONE;" : "BAD_OWNER;";
echo QuietMethodStaticInheritedCVTarget::counter() === 4 ? "STATIC;" : "BAD_STATIC;";
$watch = null;
$readerWeak = null;
$sourceWeak = null;
$intermediateWeak = null;
echo "DONE;";
